Technical Service

Inverter & Battery Repair Services

Having trouble with your solar inverter or battery? Contact Lithium House for repair assessment, troubleshooting, and guidance on supported equipment. Our technical personnel perform detailed diagnostic checks to locate electrical issues before advising on repair or replacement options.

Inverter Fault Assessment & Repair

Diagnosis of error codes, motherboard faults, damaged IGBT transistors, MOSFETs, cooling fan failures, and MPPT tracker anomalies.

Battery Inspection & BMS Diagnosis

Lithium cell voltage balancing inspection, Battery Management System (BMS) communication troubleshooting, and deep-cycle battery health assessment.

* Please note: Repair feasibility depends on the specific equipment model, nature of the fault, availability of genuine replacement components, and safety standards. An upfront assessment is required.
